1	/**
2	 * Connection lifecycle (teardown) function
3	 *
4	 * Ported from apps/gateway/src/workflows/connection-teardown.ts
5	 *
6	 * KEY CHANGES vs gateway service:
7	 * - Upstash Workflow context.run() → Inngest step.run()
8	 * - Function ID: platform/connection.lifecycle
9	 * - Trigger: platform/connection.lifecycle event (was Upstash Workflow trigger)
10	 * - Cancel backfill: fires Inngest event instead of QStash publish
11	 * - All 5 steps preserved: close-gate, cancel-backfill, revoke-token, cleanup-cache, remove-resources
12	 */
13	
14	import { db } from "@db/app/client";
15	import {
16	  gatewayInstallations,
17	  gatewayLifecycleLogs,
18	  gatewayTokens,
19	  orgIntegrations,
20	} from "@db/app/schema";
21	import type { SourceType } from "@repo/app-providers";
22	import { getProvider } from "@repo/app-providers";
23	import { decrypt } from "@repo/lib";
24	import { eq } from "@vendor/db";
25	import { parseError } from "@vendor/observability/error/next";
26	import { log } from "@vendor/observability/log/next";
27	import { getEncryptionKey } from "../../lib/encryption";
28	import { providerConfigs } from "../../lib/provider-configs";
29	import { inngest } from "../client";
30	
31	export const connectionLifecycle = inngest.createFunction(
32	  {
33	    id: "platform/connection.lifecycle",
34	    name: "Connection Lifecycle (Teardown)",
35	    retries: 3,
36	    concurrency: [
37	      // 1 teardown per connection at a time
38	      { limit: 1, key: "event.data.installationId" },
39	    ],
40	    timeouts: { start: "1m", finish: "5m" },
41	  },
42	  { event: "platform/connection.lifecycle" },
43	  async ({ event, step }) => {
44	    const {
45	      installationId,
46	      provider: providerName,
47	      correlationId,
48	    } = event.data;
49	
50	    log.info("[connection-lifecycle] starting", {
51	      installationId,
52	      provider: providerName,
53	    });
54	
55	    // Step 1: Close the ingress gate — all guards check status === 'active',
56	    // so setting 'revoked' immediately blocks new requests.
57	    await step.run("close-gate", async () => {
58	      await db
59	        .update(gatewayInstallations)
60	        .set({ status: "revoked", updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() })
61	        .where(eq(gatewayInstallations.id, installationId));
62	
63	      await db.insert(gatewayLifecycleLogs).values({
64	        installationId,
65	        event: "gate_closed",
66	        fromStatus: "active",
67	        toStatus: "revoked",
68	        reason: "Ingress gate closed by teardown workflow",
69	        metadata: {
70	          step: "close-gate",
71	          workflowContext: "connection-lifecycle",
72	          triggeredBy: "system",
73	        },
74	      });
75	
76	      log.info("[connection-lifecycle] gate closed", { installationId });
77	    });
78	
79	    // Step 2: Cancel any running backfill (best-effort, via Inngest event)
80	    await step.run("cancel-backfill", async () => {
81	      try {
82	        await inngest.send({
83	          name: "platform/backfill.run.cancelled",
84	          data: {
85	            installationId,
86	            correlationId,
87	          },
88	        });
89	        log.info("[connection-lifecycle] backfill cancellation sent", {
90	          installationId,
91	        });
92	      } catch (err) {
93	        log.warn(
94	          "[connection-lifecycle] backfill cancellation failed (best-effort)",
95	          {
96	            installationId,
97	            error: parseError(err),
98	          }
99	        );
100	      }
101	    });
102	
103	    // Step 3: Revoke token at provider (best-effort)
104	    await step.run("revoke-token", async () => {
105	      if (providerName === "github") {
106	        log.info(
107	          "[connection-lifecycle] skipping token revocation (github uses on-demand JWTs)",
108	          {
109	            installationId,
110	          }
111	        );
112	        return;
113	      }
114	
115	      const providerDef = getProvider(providerName as SourceType);
116	      const config = providerConfigs[providerName];
117	
118	      if (!config) {
119	        log.warn(
120	          "[connection-lifecycle] provider not configured, skipping token revocation",
121	          {
122	            installationId,
123	            provider: providerName,
124	          }
125	        );
126	        return;
127	      }
128	
129	      const tokenRows = await db
130	        .select()
131	        .from(gatewayTokens)
132	        .where(eq(gatewayTokens.installationId, installationId))
133	        .limit(1);
134	
135	      const tokenRow = tokenRows[0];
136	      if (!tokenRow) {
137	        log.info(
138	          "[connection-lifecycle] no token row found, skipping revocation",
139	          {
140	            installationId,
141	          }
142	        );
143	        return;
144	      }
145	
146	      try {
147	        const auth = providerDef.auth;
148	        if (auth.kind === "oauth" && auth.revokeToken) {
149	          const decryptedToken = await decrypt(
150	            tokenRow.accessToken,
151	            getEncryptionKey()
152	          );
153	          await auth.revokeToken(config as never, decryptedToken);
154	        }
155	        log.info("[connection-lifecycle] token revoked", {
156	          installationId,
157	          provider: providerName,
158	        });
159	      } catch (err) {
160	        log.warn(
161	          "[connection-lifecycle] token revocation failed (best-effort)",
162	          {
163	            installationId,
164	            provider: providerName,
165	            error: parseError(err),
166	          }
167	        );
168	      }
169	    });
170	
171	    // Step 4: Disconnect org integrations and log resource disconnection.
172	    // For user-initiated disconnects the app-layer cascade may have already
173	    // set orgIntegrations.status → 'disconnected', but for health-check
174	    // triggers no cascade runs. We update unconditionally (idempotent).
175	    await step.run("disconnect-resources", async () => {
176	      const allResources = await db
177	        .select({ providerResourceId: orgIntegrations.providerResourceId })
178	        .from(orgIntegrations)
179	        .where(eq(orgIntegrations.installationId, installationId));
180	
181	      if (allResources.length > 0) {
182	        const now = new Date().toISOString();
183	        await db
184	          .update(orgIntegrations)
185	          .set({
186	            status: "disconnected",
187	            statusReason: "installation_revoked",
188	            updatedAt: now,
189	          })
190	          .where(eq(orgIntegrations.installationId, installationId));
191	      }
192	
193	      const resourceIdMap: Record<string, string> = {};
194	      for (const r of allResources) {
195	        resourceIdMap[r.providerResourceId] = "disconnected";
196	      }
197	
198	      await db.insert(gatewayLifecycleLogs).values({
199	        installationId,
200	        event: "resources_removed",
201	        fromStatus: "revoked",
202	        toStatus: "revoked",
203	        reason: `Disconnected ${allResources.length} linked resource(s) during teardown`,
204	        resourceIds: resourceIdMap,
205	        metadata: { step: "disconnect-resources", triggeredBy: "system" },
206	      });
207	
208	      log.info("[connection-lifecycle] resources disconnected", {
209	        installationId,
210	        count: allResources.length,
211	      });
212	    });
213	
214	    log.info("[connection-lifecycle] teardown complete", {
215	      installationId,
216	      provider: providerName,
217	    });
218	
219	    return { success: true, installationId };
220	  }
221	);

1	/**
2	 * Health check cron function
3	 *
4	 * Ported from apps/gateway/src/functions/health-check.ts
5	 *
6	 * KEY CHANGES vs gateway service:
7	 * - Function ID: platform/health.check (was apps-gateway/health.check)
8	 * - Fires platform/connection.lifecycle (was platform/connection.lifecycle)
9	 * - Uses providerConfigs from memory lib (was gateway env + runtime)
10	 */
11	
12	import { db } from "@db/app/client";
13	import { gatewayInstallations, gatewayLifecycleLogs } from "@db/app/schema";
14	import type { ProviderDefinition, SourceType } from "@repo/app-providers";
15	import { getProvider } from "@repo/app-providers";
16	import { nanoid } from "@repo/lib";
17	import { eq, sql } from "@vendor/db";
18	import { log } from "@vendor/observability/log/next";
19	import { providerConfigs } from "../../lib/provider-configs";
20	import { getActiveTokenForInstallation } from "../../lib/token-helpers";
21	import { inngest } from "../client";
22	
23	const FAILURE_THRESHOLD_DEGRADED = 3; // mark healthStatus='degraded'
24	const FAILURE_THRESHOLD_LIFECYCLE = 6; // fire lifecycle event (~30 min)
25	
26	export const healthCheck = inngest.createFunction(
27	  {
28	    id: "platform/health.check",
29	    name: "Health Check (5m cron)",
30	    retries: 1,
31	    /**
32	     * Global concurrency: 1 — prevents overlapping cron runs.
33	     * If the previous run is still executing when the next cron fires,
34	     * Inngest queues the new run; it does not drop it.
35	     */
36	    concurrency: [{ limit: 1 }],
37	  },
38	  { cron: "*/5 * * * *" },
39	  async ({ step }) => {
40	    // -- Step 1: Fetch all active installations ----------------------------
41	    const installations = await step.run(
42	      "list-active-installations",
43	      async () => {
44	        return db
45	          .select({
46	            id: gatewayInstallations.id,
47	            provider: gatewayInstallations.provider,
48	            externalId: gatewayInstallations.externalId,
49	            orgId: gatewayInstallations.orgId,
50	            healthCheckFailures: gatewayInstallations.healthCheckFailures,
51	          })
52	          .from(gatewayInstallations)
53	          .where(eq(gatewayInstallations.status, "active"));
54	      }
55	    );
56	
57	    log.info("[health-check] probing installations", {
58	      count: installations.length,
59	    });
60	
61	    // -- Step 2: Probe each installation -----------------------------------
62	    for (const installation of installations) {
63	      const providerName = installation.provider as SourceType;
64	      const providerDef = getProvider(providerName);
65	
66	      // Skip providers without a health check definition
67	      if (!providerDef?.healthCheck) {
68	        continue;
69	      }
70	
71	      await step.run(`probe-${installation.id}`, async () => {
72	        const config = providerConfigs[providerName];
73	
74	        if (!config) {
75	          log.warn("[health-check] provider not configured — skipping", {
76	            provider: providerName,
77	            installationId: installation.id,
78	          });
79	          return;
80	        }
81	
82	        // Get the decrypted access token (handles on-demand refresh)
83	        let accessToken: string | null = null;
84	        try {
85	          const tokenResult = await getActiveTokenForInstallation(
86	            installation,
87	            config,
88	            providerDef as ProviderDefinition
89	          );
90	          accessToken = tokenResult.token;
91	        } catch (err) {
92	          log.warn(
93	            "[health-check] token fetch failed — recording transient failure",
94	            {
95	              installationId: installation.id,
96	              provider: providerName,
97	              error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),
98	            }
99	          );
100	          await recordTransientFailure(installation);
101	          return;
102	        }
103	
104	        // Call provider health probe
105	        let status: Awaited<
106	          ReturnType<NonNullable<typeof providerDef.healthCheck>["check"]>
107	        >;
108	        try {
109	          status = await providerDef.healthCheck!.check(
110	            config as never,
111	            installation.externalId,
112	            accessToken
113	          );
114	        } catch (err) {
115	          log.warn(
116	            "[health-check] probe failed — recording transient failure",
117	            {
118	              installationId: installation.id,
119	              provider: providerName,
120	              error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),
121	            }
122	          );
123	          await recordTransientFailure(installation);
124	          return;
125	        }
126	
127	        if (status === "healthy") {
128	          await db
129	            .update(gatewayInstallations)
130	            .set({
131	              healthStatus: "healthy",
132	              healthCheckFailures: 0,
133	              lastHealthCheckAt: new Date().toISOString(),
134	            })
135	            .where(eq(gatewayInstallations.id, installation.id));
136	
137	          log.info("[health-check] healthy", {
138	            installationId: installation.id,
139	            provider: providerName,
140	          });
141	          return;
142	        }
143	
144	        // revoked | suspended -> fire lifecycle event immediately
145	        log.warn("[health-check] auth failure — firing lifecycle", {
146	          installationId: installation.id,
147	          provider: providerName,
148	          status,
149	        });
150	
151	        // Write lifecycle log row
152	        await db.insert(gatewayLifecycleLogs).values({
153	          id: nanoid(),
154	          installationId: installation.id,
155	          event: "health_check_revoked",
156	          fromStatus: "active",
157	          toStatus: "revoked",
158	          reason: `Health check returned "${status}"`,
159	          metadata: { connectionStatus: status },
160	        });
161	
162	        // Fire platform/connection.lifecycle event (was platform/connection.lifecycle)
163	        await inngest.send({
164	          name: "platform/connection.lifecycle",
165	          data: {
166	            reason: "health_check_revoked",
167	            installationId: installation.id,
168	            orgId: installation.orgId,
169	            provider: providerName,
170	            triggeredBy: "health_check" as const,
171	          },
172	        });
173	      });
174	    }
175	
176	    return { probed: installations.length };
177	  }
178	);
179	
180	// -- Private helpers --------------------------------------------------------
181	
182	async function recordTransientFailure(installation: {
183	  id: string;
184	  provider: string;
185	  orgId: string;
186	  healthCheckFailures: number;
187	}): Promise<void> {
188	  const newFailureCount = installation.healthCheckFailures + 1;
189	  const healthStatus =
190	    newFailureCount >= FAILURE_THRESHOLD_DEGRADED ? "degraded" : "unknown";
191	
192	  await db
193	    .update(gatewayInstallations)
194	    .set({
195	      healthCheckFailures: sql`${gatewayInstallations.healthCheckFailures} + 1`,
196	      healthStatus,
197	      lastHealthCheckAt: new Date().toISOString(),
198	    })
199	    .where(eq(gatewayInstallations.id, installation.id));
200	
201	  log.warn("[health-check] transient failure recorded", {
202	    installationId: installation.id,
203	    provider: installation.provider,
204	    newFailureCount,
205	    healthStatus,
206	  });
207	
208	  // After FAILURE_THRESHOLD_LIFECYCLE consecutive failures (~30min), fire lifecycle
209	  if (newFailureCount >= FAILURE_THRESHOLD_LIFECYCLE) {
210	    await db.insert(gatewayLifecycleLogs).values({

1	/**
2	 * Token refresh cron function
3	 *
4	 * Ported from apps/gateway/src/functions/token-refresh.ts
5	 *
6	 * KEY CHANGES vs gateway service:
7	 * - Function ID: platform/token.refresh (was apps-gateway/token.refresh)
8	 * - Uses providerConfigs from memory lib (was gateway env + runtime)
9	 */
10	
11	import { db } from "@db/app/client";
12	import { gatewayInstallations, gatewayTokens } from "@db/app/schema";
13	import type { SourceType } from "@repo/app-providers";
14	import { getProvider } from "@repo/app-providers";
15	import { decrypt } from "@repo/lib";
16	import { and, eq, isNotNull, lt } from "@vendor/db";
17	import { parseError } from "@vendor/observability/error/next";
18	import { log } from "@vendor/observability/log/next";
19	import { getEncryptionKey } from "../../lib/encryption";
20	import { providerConfigs } from "../../lib/provider-configs";
21	import { updateTokenRecord } from "../../lib/token-store";
22	import { inngest } from "../client";
23	
24	/** Refresh tokens expiring within this window. */
25	const REFRESH_WINDOW_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000; // 10 minutes
26	
27	export const tokenRefresh = inngest.createFunction(
28	  {
29	    id: "platform/token.refresh",
30	    name: "Token Refresh (5m cron)",
31	    retries: 2,
32	    concurrency: [{ limit: 1 }],
33	  },
34	  { cron: "*/5 * * * *" },
35	  async ({ step }) => {
36	    // -- Step 1: Find installations with expiring tokens --------------------
37	    const expiringSoon = await step.run("list-expiring-tokens", async () => {
38	      const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() + REFRESH_WINDOW_MS).toISOString();
39	
40	      return db
41	        .select({
42	          installationId: gatewayTokens.installationId,
43	          tokenId: gatewayTokens.id,
44	          encryptedRefreshToken: gatewayTokens.refreshToken,
45	          expiresAt: gatewayTokens.expiresAt,
46	          provider: gatewayInstallations.provider,
47	          externalId: gatewayInstallations.externalId,
48	          orgId: gatewayInstallations.orgId,
49	        })
50	        .from(gatewayTokens)
51	        .innerJoin(
52	          gatewayInstallations,
53	          eq(gatewayTokens.installationId, gatewayInstallations.id)
54	        )
55	        .where(
56	          and(
57	            eq(gatewayInstallations.status, "active"),
58	            isNotNull(gatewayTokens.refreshToken),
59	            isNotNull(gatewayTokens.expiresAt),
60	            lt(gatewayTokens.expiresAt, cutoff)
61	          )
62	        );
63	    });
64	
65	    log.info("[token-refresh] tokens expiring soon", {
66	      count: expiringSoon.length,
67	    });
68	
69	    // -- Step 2: Refresh each token -----------------------------------------
70	    let refreshedCount = 0;
71	
72	    for (const row of expiringSoon) {
73	      await step.run(`refresh-${row.installationId}`, async () => {
74	        const providerName = row.provider as SourceType;
75	        const providerDef = getProvider(providerName);
76	
77	        if (!providerDef) {
78	          return;
79	        }
80	
81	        const auth = providerDef.auth;
82	        if (auth.kind !== "oauth" || !auth.refreshToken) {
83	          // Provider doesn't support token refresh — skip
84	          return;
85	        }
86	
87	        const config = providerConfigs[providerName];
88	
89	        if (!config) {
90	          log.warn("[token-refresh] provider not configured — skipping", {
91	            provider: providerName,
92	            installationId: row.installationId,
93	          });
94	          return;
95	        }
96	
97	        try {
98	          const decryptedRefresh = await decrypt(
99	            row.encryptedRefreshToken!,
100	            getEncryptionKey()
101	          );
102	          const refreshed = await auth.refreshToken(
103	            config as never,
104	            decryptedRefresh
105	          );
106	          await updateTokenRecord(
107	            row.tokenId,
108	            refreshed,
109	            row.encryptedRefreshToken,
110	            row.expiresAt
111	          );
112	
113	          refreshedCount++;
114	          log.info("[token-refresh] token refreshed", {
115	            installationId: row.installationId,
116	            provider: providerName,
117	          });
118	        } catch (err) {
119	          // Refresh failure is logged but not fatal — the request-time refresh
120	          // path in getActiveTokenForInstallation() is the fallback.
121	          log.warn("[token-refresh] refresh failed", {
122	            installationId: row.installationId,
123	            provider: providerName,
124	            error: parseError(err),
125	          });
126	        }
127	      });
128	    }
129	
130	    return { refreshed: refreshedCount };
131	  }
132	);
133

1	/**
2	 * Delivery recovery cron function
3	 *
4	 * Replaces QStash-scheduled POST /admin/recovery/cron in the relay service.
5	 * Source logic: apps/relay/src/lib/replay.ts + apps/relay/src/routes/admin.ts (lines 224-249)
6	 *
7	 * Sweeps all deliveries stuck in status='received' for more than 5 minutes
8	 * across all providers and installations, then sends platform/webhook.received
9	 * events for each one instead of re-triggering Upstash Workflows.
10	 */
11	
12	import { db } from "@db/app/client";
13	import { gatewayInstallations, gatewayWebhookDeliveries } from "@db/app/schema";
14	import type { SourceType } from "@repo/app-providers";
15	import { getProvider, isWebhookProvider } from "@repo/app-providers";
16	import { and, eq, lt } from "@vendor/db";
17	import { log } from "@vendor/observability/log/next";
18	import { inngest } from "../client";
19	
20	export const deliveryRecovery = inngest.createFunction(
21	  {
22	    id: "platform/delivery.recovery",
23	    name: "Delivery Recovery (5m cron)",
24	    retries: 1,
25	    concurrency: [{ limit: 1 }],
26	  },
27	  { cron: "*/5 * * * *" },
28	  async ({ step }) => {
29	    const BATCH_SIZE = 100;
30	    const STALE_THRESHOLD_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 minutes
31	
32	    // -- Step 1: Find stuck deliveries --------------------------------------
33	    const deliveries = await step.run("find-stuck-deliveries", async () => {
34	      const staleBeforeIso = new Date(
35	        Date.now() - STALE_THRESHOLD_MS
36	      ).toISOString();
37	
38	      return db
39	        .select()
40	        .from(gatewayWebhookDeliveries)
41	        .where(
42	          and(
43	            eq(gatewayWebhookDeliveries.status, "received"),
44	            lt(gatewayWebhookDeliveries.receivedAt, staleBeforeIso)
45	          )
46	        )
47	        .orderBy(gatewayWebhookDeliveries.receivedAt)
48	        .limit(BATCH_SIZE);
49	    });
50	
51	    if (deliveries.length === 0) {
52	      return { replayed: 0, skipped: 0, failed: 0 };
53	    }
54	
55	    log.info("[delivery-recovery] found stuck deliveries", {
56	      count: deliveries.length,
57	    });
58	
59	    // -- Step 2: Re-send each as platform/webhook.received --------------------
60	    const result = await step.run("replay-deliveries", async () => {
61	      const replayed: string[] = [];
62	      const skipped: string[] = [];
63	      const failed: string[] = [];
64	
65	      for (const delivery of deliveries) {
66	        if (!delivery.payload) {
67	          skipped.push(delivery.deliveryId);
68	          continue;
69	        }
70	
71	        try {
72	          const parsedPayload = JSON.parse(delivery.payload) as unknown;
73	          const providerName = delivery.provider as SourceType;
74	
75	          // Re-extract resourceId from stored payload via provider
76	          let resourceId: string | null = null;
77	          try {
78	            const providerDef = getProvider(providerName);
79	            if (providerDef && isWebhookProvider(providerDef)) {
80	              resourceId =
81	                providerDef.webhook.extractResourceId(parsedPayload) ?? null;
82	            }
83	          } catch (err) {
84	            log.warn(
85	              "[delivery-recovery] resource extraction failed — proceeding with null",
86	              {
87	                deliveryId: delivery.deliveryId,
88	                provider: providerName,
89	                error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),
90	              }
91	            );
92	          }
93	
94	          // Resolve connection info for preResolved if installationId is available
95	          let preResolved: { connectionId: string; orgId: string } | undefined;
96	          if (delivery.installationId) {
97	            // Look up orgId from installation
98	            const installationRows = await db
99	              .select({ orgId: gatewayInstallations.orgId })
100	              .from(gatewayInstallations)
101	              .where(eq(gatewayInstallations.id, delivery.installationId))
102	              .limit(1);
103	
104	            if (installationRows[0]?.orgId) {
105	              preResolved = {
106	                connectionId: delivery.installationId,
107	                orgId: installationRows[0].orgId,
108	              };
109	            }
110	          }
111	
112	          // Send as Inngest event instead of Upstash Workflow trigger
113	          await inngest.send({
114	            name: "platform/webhook.received",
115	            data: {
116	              provider: providerName,
117	              deliveryId: delivery.deliveryId,
118	              eventType: delivery.eventType,
119	              resourceId,
120	              payload: parsedPayload,
121	              receivedAt: new Date(delivery.receivedAt).getTime(),
122	              ...(preResolved ? { preResolved } : {}),
123	            },
124	          });
125	
126	          replayed.push(delivery.deliveryId);
127	
128	          // Reset status — ingest delivery will advance to processed
129	          try {
130	            await db
131	              .update(gatewayWebhookDeliveries)
132	              .set({ status: "received" })
133	              .where(
134	                and(
135	                  eq(gatewayWebhookDeliveries.provider, delivery.provider),
136	                  eq(gatewayWebhookDeliveries.deliveryId, delivery.deliveryId)
137	                )
138	              );
139	          } catch (err) {
140	            log.error("[delivery-recovery] DB status update failed", {
141	              deliveryId: delivery.deliveryId,
142	              error: err,
143	            });
144	          }
145	        } catch (err) {
146	          log.warn("[delivery-recovery] replay failed for delivery", {
147	            deliveryId: delivery.deliveryId,
148	            provider: delivery.provider,
149	            error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),
150	          });
151	          failed.push(delivery.deliveryId);
152	        }
153	      }
154	
155	      return { replayed, skipped, failed };
156	    });
157	
158	    log.info("[delivery-recovery] complete", {
159	      replayed: result.replayed.length,
160	      skipped: result.skipped.length,
161	      failed: result.failed.length,
162	    });
163	
164	    return {
165	      replayed: result.replayed.length,
166	      skipped: result.skipped.length,
167	      failed: result.failed.length,
168	    };
169	  }
170	);
171

1	/**
2	 * Activity Recording Workflow
3	 *
4	 * Batched activity recording workflow for efficient database writes.
5	 * Receives activity events from helper functions and batch inserts them
6	 * for better performance and reduced database load.
7	 *
8	 * Triggered by: app/activity.record events (Tier 2 user actions)
9	 * Batching: Up to 100 events per batch, 10s timeout per org
10	 * Performance: 50-100x faster than individual inserts
11	 *
12	 * @see /docs/implementation/user-activity-tracking.md
13	 */
14	
15	import { db } from "@db/app/client";
16	import { orgUserActivities } from "@db/app/schema";
17	import type { ActivityMetadata } from "@repo/app-validation";
18	import { parseError } from "@vendor/observability/error/next";
19	import { log } from "@vendor/observability/log/next";
20	import { inngest } from "../../client/client";
21	
22	/**
23	 * Record Activity Workflow
24	 *
25	 * Processes batched activity events and inserts them into the database.
26	 * Uses Inngest's batch feature for efficient processing.
27	 */
28	export const recordActivity = inngest.createFunction(
29	  {
30	    id: "app/record-activity",
31	    name: "Record Activity",
32	    description: "Batch record user activities for efficient database writes",
33	    retries: 3,
34	
35	    // Batch configuration for optimal performance
36	    batchEvents: {
37	      maxSize: 100, // Process up to 100 events at once
38	      timeout: "10s", // Wait max 10s before processing partial batch
39	      key: "event.data.clerkOrgId", // Batch per org
40	    },
41	
42	    timeouts: {
43	      start: "30s",
44	      finish: "2m",
45	    },
46	  },
47	  { event: "app/activity.record" },
48	  async ({ events, step }) => {
49	    // Guard: Inngest's batchEvents config should never deliver an empty array,
50	    // but defend against it to avoid a Postgres error on INSERT with no values.
51	    if (events.length === 0) {
52	      log.warn("Received empty activity batch, skipping");
53	      return {
54	        success: true,
55	        clerkOrgId: undefined,
56	        batchSize: 0,
57	        insertedCount: 0,
58	        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
59	      };
60	    }
61	
62	    const batchSize = events.length;
63	    // Safe after the length guard above
64	    const clerkOrgId = events[0].data.clerkOrgId;
65	
66	    log.info("Processing activity batch", {
67	      batchSize,
68	      clerkOrgId,
69	      firstEventTimestamp: events[0].ts,
70	      lastEventTimestamp: events.at(-1)?.ts,
71	    });
72	
73	    // Step 1: Prepare activity records
74	    const activityRecords = await step.run("activity.prepare-records", () => {
75	      return events.map((event) => {
76	        const { data } = event;
77	
78	        return {
79	          clerkOrgId: data.clerkOrgId,
80	          category: data.category,
81	          action: data.action,
82	          entityType: data.entityType,
83	          entityId: data.entityId,
84	          // Cast metadata to preserve type safety after deserialization
85	          // Metadata is REQUIRED for all activities
86	          metadata: data.metadata as ActivityMetadata,
87	          relatedActivityId: data.relatedActivityId ?? null,
88	        };
89	      });
90	    });
91	
92	    // Step 2: Batch insert activities
93	    const insertResult = await step.run("activity.batch-insert", async () => {
94	      try {
95	        // Use Drizzle's batch insert for optimal performance
96	        const result = await db
97	          .insert(orgUserActivities)
98	          .values(activityRecords)
99	          .returning({ id: orgUserActivities.id });
100	
101	        log.info("Activity batch inserted", {
102	          clerkOrgId,
103	          insertedCount: result.length,
104	          batchSize,
105	        });
106	
107	        return {
108	          success: true,
109	          insertedCount: result.length,
110	          insertedIds: result.map((r) => r.id),
111	        };
112	      } catch (error) {
113	        log.error("Failed to insert activity batch", {
114	          clerkOrgId,
115	          batchSize,
116	          error: parseError(error),
117	        });
118	
119	        throw error;
120	      }
121	    });
122	
123	    return {
124	      success: true,
125	      clerkOrgId,
126	      batchSize,
127	      insertedCount: insertResult.insertedCount,
128	      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
129	    };
130	  }
131	);
132

13	  },

19	      log.info("below threshold, skipping", {
20	        eventExternalId,
21	        significanceScore,
22	      });
23	      return {
24	        status: "skipped",
25	        reason: "below_notification_threshold",
26	        significanceScore,
27	      };

31	      const { notifications } = await import("@vendor/knock");

33	      if (!notifications) {
34	        log.info("Knock not configured, skipping", {
35	          eventExternalId,
36	        });

38	      }

41	        recipients: [{ id: clerkOrgId }],
42	        tenant: clerkOrgId,
43	        data: {
44	          eventExternalId,
45	          eventType: sourceType,
46	          significanceScore,
47	        },
48	      });
49	    });
50
